display_goal: Call a pharmacy on behalf of a patient looking for medication. Identify yourself immediately as an automated assistant, keep the call brief and polite, and ask whether they currently have amoxicillin 500mg in stock; the patient needs 21 capsules. Capture structured results using exactly these key names: in_stock (yes, no, partial, or unknown; use partial if they have some but fewer than 21 capsules), form_available (brand, generic, both, or unknown), quantity_available (integer units they have), unit_price (number, price per unit), currency (three-letter currency code), requires_prescription (yes, no, or unknown), can_hold (yes, no, or unknown), hold_duration_hours (number of hours they will hold it), alternative_suggested (any alternative or other branch they mention), pharmacist_notes (anything else useful, one short sentence). If they do not have it, still ask about alternatives or another branch. Do not place an order or commit to anything on the patient's behalf. Thank them and end the call. If nobody answers, report that the pharmacy could not be reached; do not treat that as a successful stock check.
